notes.title: Ruya: Ascension
notes.content:
[h2]Game Announcement![/h2]

It's been [b]7 years[/b] since Miracle Tea released the original Ruya and we're celebrating this anniversary by announcing a brand new game! Our team has been busy working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230930/Ruya_Ascension/][b]Ruya: Ascension[/b][/url], a trippy sequel to the original puzzle game!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230930/Ruya_Ascension/]Wishlist Ruya: Ascension Here![/url][/b]

[h2]Community[/h2]

Join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ][b]Discord [/b][/url]to stay up to date with our  development and tell us what you think so far!

- Miracle Tea

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Been a while since we've updated Ruya here, so we're starting off with a small update just by enabling Steam's Cloud Save, enjoy!

We've got some cool stuff in the works related to Ruya, so keep your eyes peeled.

- Miracle Tea
